LanguageData.Deathrest.description: A deep coma-like sleep that lasts several days and restores the body's resources. Certain genes create a need for torpor. Torpor can also be enhanced with various support buildings that give special bonuses to the sleeper.
LanguageData.Deathrest.label: torpor
LanguageData.DeathrestExhaustion.description: This person desperately needs to enter torpor to rebalance their metabolism.
LanguageData.DeathrestExhaustion.label: torpor exhaustion
LanguageData.GlucosoidRush.description: Move speed is increased because this person used a glucosoid pump while in torpor. This effect lasts until the next torpor.
LanguageData.HemogenAmplified.description: All blood gains are multiplied up because this person used a blood amplifier while in torpor. This effect lasts until the next torpor.
LanguageData.HemogenAmplified.label: blood amplified
LanguageData.HemogenCraving.description: Due to a lack of blood, this person's body is breaking down their own bone marrow. This causes disorientation and a painful craving for human blood.
LanguageData.HemogenCraving.label: blood craving
LanguageData.InterruptedDeathrest.description: Torpor was interrupted while this person's metabolism was still out of balance. They will be sick for days while regaining equilibrium.
LanguageData.InterruptedDeathrest.label: interrupted torpor
LanguageData.PsychofluidRush.description: Psychic sensitivity is enhanced because this person used a psychofluid pump while in torpor. This effect lasts until the next torpor.
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedAnimalHemogen.description: Feeding on animal blood increases the regeneration and combat capabilities of the user, but greatly decreases the ability to communicate with others.
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedAnimalHemogen.label: consumed animal blood
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedCorpseHemogen.description: Corpse blood greatly weakens those who consume it, but increases consciousness and blood filtration significantly.
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedCorpseHemogen.label: consumed corpse blood
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedSanguophageHemogen.descripti: Consuming the power from the blood of other vampires gives one a powerful boost to all capacities.
LanguageData.VRE_ConsumedSanguophageHemogen.label: consumed vampire blood
LanguageData.VRE_HemogenAmplifiedWeak.description: All blood gains are multiplied up because this person used a small blood amplifier while deathresting. This effect lasts until the next torpor.
LanguageData.VRE_HemogenAmplifiedWeak.label: blood amplified, weak
LanguageData.VRE_SolidifiedHemogen.description: Armor is enhanced because this person used a blood solidifier while in torpor. This effect lasts until the next torpor.
LanguageData.VRE_SolidifiedHemogen.label: solidified blood
